page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The system is powered by Intel Xeon 8369HB processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. It features 96 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyper-threading overhead.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include any local storage or GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be handled via network-attached options, and workloads requiring hardware acceleration are not supported. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation make this instance suitable for memory-bound enterprise applications. Tradeoffs include the complete reliance on network storage and the lack of complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This profile is configured for workloads such as in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, and enterprise resource planning systems.
